sources.snippet: RLVE OPD teacher: Integral DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B trained for 150 steps on difficulty-0 Integral prompts, with four prompts and 16 rollouts per step. Training did not use DAPO prompt filtering. These are the final model weights at step 149 for environment-specific on-policy distillation.
